title: UniversalBandDeclarationMetadata
description: Protocol-root universal-band DAG — the wisdom-as-system-auth layer that wraps every relational-impact invocation (spec §P1, §2.5). Structurally identical to a GateProcessDeclaration but scoped to protocol-reach governance rather than app-reach. Referenced by a well-known constitutional pointer; every elohim loads it at startup.

version.description: Semantic version of this universal-band declaration.

activatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when protocol governance ratified this declaration.

supersedes.description: CID of a superseded universal-band-declaration, or null for the first.

dag.description: The universal-band step graph. Runs for every invocation regardless of app context.

governanceReach.description: Universal band is always governed at protocol reach.

ratificationAttestationCids.description: CIDs of protocol-reach ratification attestations that authorized activation.
